title: csdlc-bind does not consume source staging or materialize issue evidence
evidence: csdlc-bind copied .csdlc/issues/291 and .csdlc/prepared/issues/291 into the bound worktree and recorded bound topology there.
Primary-root .csdlc/issues/291, .csdlc/prepared/issues/291, .csdlc/evidence/291, and .csdlc/locks/291.lock remained as untracked pre-bind staging residue after bind.
Bound design referenced .csdlc/evidence/291/review-r2-findings.json, but .csdlc/evidence/291 was not materialized by bind.
Installed csdlc-clean supports terminal exact-worktree classify/remove only and has no source-staging reconciliation operation.

acceptance: After successful bind, source pre-bind staging is either consumed through typed authority or classified as retained residue with exact recovery metadata.
Issue evidence referenced by prepared design/review truth is materialized into the bound worktree or bind fails closed with an explicit diagnostic.
No manual copy/delete is needed for ordinary post-bind source-staging reconciliation.
